rawContent: I will be filling the @BBCRadioManc airwaves very shortly (from 10am), discussing #BlackLivesMatter and the protests in America with Mike Sweeney. You can listen LIVE and free here: https://t.co/1kc38hf7dW https://t.co/vqQFtXDpKf

#BlackLivesMatter. If you missed me on @BBCRadioManc this morning, discussing #racism, the protests in America, and #activism with Mike Sweeney, you can listen (or revisit!) entirely at your leisure here: https://t.co/Hk59poxH8Q https://t.co/7EauA9egnm

Don't forget I'll shortly be getting comfortable on the @GMB @ITV sofa with some uncomfortable truths at around 7:45am. I'll be talking #EverydayActivism, #BlackLivesMatter and importantly how you could, should, and indeed can #BeTheChange you want to see in the world. https://t.co/wgrKfV1Zgj
Heading onto @LeBatardShow at 4pm UK time (15 mins from now!) and looking forward to the conversation... pretty sure it will be around #BlackLivesMatter and my recent victory in #StumpTheMeech

A pleasure to speak to @EwanMacKenna just now, recording an episode of #TheBlackEye podcast. Refreshing to be able to cast a critical unvarnished eye on the world of sport and, of course, #BlackLivesMatter  I will let you all know when it’s published.

Which leads me to the last, but certainly not least, opportunity to share #BeTheChange: joining @HughWoozencroft on @talkSPORTKO at 8:30pm UK time to discuss sport, race, politics and #BlackLivesMatter  Details on the various ways to listen live and free: https://t.co/bSsA0ov17F

i hope fellow early-risers will join me tomorrow morning at 07:20am BST with @kasujja and @KarnieSharp on #BBCNewsday @bbcworldservice to discuss this week’s #BlackLivesMatter events, privilege, and where the world goes from here. You can listen LIVE at: https://t.co/UCE5FAIIyK https://t.co/7MWMW7fdNO

Rising with the lark! On #BBCNewsday in 20 mins with @kasujja and @KarnieSharp discussing #BlackLivesMatter, the pitfalls of personal privilege and how to remedy it, and what the future may hold. Listen at: https://t.co/UCE5FAIIyK @bbcworldservice https://t.co/TcUjinO1mn

For a group of people who’ve supposedly committed to listening, learning and reflecting around #BlackLivesMatter there are a hell of a lot of “allies” doing a LOT of “explaining” and demanding on here.

Funny that we don’t make progress towards equality.

#JediReflections suggestions! I’m so glad these videos continue to be valued and touch upon topics you find important. We’ve no shortage of salient points to cover! But I do want to prioritise; what would you like next? #BlackLivesMatter? #COVID19? #DandI? #FutureOfWork? Other?

Grateful to @theJeremyVine for inviting me onto his @BBCRadio2 show yesterday - an important platform for highlighting what privilege actually is in the context of #BlackLivesMatter and #RacialEquality. Listen here: https://t.co/JwFVdWAVjM My "bit" is at 1:16:45. Please do RT! https://t.co/fwSZw6WmfQ
